question: Which famous European footballer passed away in December, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paolo Rossi**__.

__
 
• **Paolo Rossi **was a famous **European footballer** who passed away in December 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paolo Rossi** was an** Italian professional footballer** who played as a forward.
 
• In 1982, he** led Italy** to the **1982 FIFA World Cup title**, scoring **six goals** to win the **Golden Boot** as top goalscorer, and the **Golden Ball** for the player of the tournament. 
 
 
• **Born: **23 September 1956, Prato, Italy
 
• **Died:** 9 December 2020, Siena, Italy
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Johan Cruyff died on 24 March 2016.
 
• Bobby Moore died on 24 February 1993.
 
• Diego Maradona died on 25 November 2020.

• **​President:** Gianni Infantino

• **Robert Frederick Chelsea Moore** OBE was an **English professional footballer**.
 
 
• He most notably played for West Ham United, captaining the club for more than ten years, and was the **captain of the England national team **that** won** the **1966 FIFA World Cup.**
 
 
 
• **Hendrik Johannes Cruijff** OON was a **Dutch professional football player** and **coach**.
 
 
• As a player, he won the **Ballon d'Or three times**, in 1971, 1973, and 1974.
 
 
 
• **Diego Armando Maradona** was an **Argentine professional footballer and manager.**
